title: Charmsy x Punchy!
description: Adds physics based charms to Minecraft items using Punchy! mod, bringing extra personality and movement while staying true to the vanilla style.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71d98b49d39120cac62abac8f51db55a5e7c1e62.png)

Small charms, big personality.

Charmsy is a vanilla friendly resource pack created for Punchy Animations First Person that adds physics based charms to Minecraft items.

Features

This pack adds physics based charms to your first person items, designed specifically for Punchy Animations First Person while maintaining a vanilla friendly art style. Each tool and weapon features its own unique charm, bringing extra personality and detail to your equipment. Lightweight and immersive, the pack enhances item customization without affecting gameplay, making every item feel more alive than ever.

Whether you're exploring caves, fighting mobs, or building your next project, your items will feel more alive than ever.


![names](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/412afdfed0331f314998834b38ee09c93f1bbf9d_0.webp)
To use a charm, simply rename your sword or spear in an anvil to match one of the available names listed in the table above. Once renamed, the corresponding charm will automatically appear on your weapon.
